en: <I'm a melancholy mariner, you know>
I figured. I was only asking.
(Well, dressed like this...)
Well, even if you're not a sailor, if you've
got nowhere else to stay, come to my place.
Well, I'll be!
So you're a sailor!
Just kidding... You're a funny one.
Whether a man's a sailor or not, I can
tell that right off the bat.
is an inn just for sailors.
note: needs #3198 (slice 039) to end as a subject: e.g. 'This place, in the port town of Calstatt,'

en: If you've got nowhere else to stay,
you're welcome here anytime.
Listen, the reason I can say for sure that
you're no sailor has nothing to do with
the way you're dressed.
It's the air a person carries.
And you've got an air about you that's
a bit different from your average folk.
And another thing: I sailed for decades.
I'm retired now, mind you.
So telling a sailor from a landlubber
is no trouble at all for me.
Do you like this place that much?
Some of these rough men of the sea can't
be trusted... I was a sailor myself.
You'd do well to heed my warning.
I got dragged into a stupid brawl between
sailors myself, and I ended up losing my
right leg.
This leg I've got now is a fake... Well,
that sort of thing's nothing unusual.
It's been over 10 years since I quit sailing.
Even so, I still want to go back to sea.
I feel like I can hear the sea calling me,
so even now that I've quit, I still run
a business that caters to sailors...
I just can't let go, I guess.
Doing business with sailors like this,
I'll spend the rest of my life by the sea.
A human leg is a mere part, after all.
But I like that tough spirit of his.
He should prove useful enough.
<No, I am not a sailor>

You there,

en: , was it?
What are you after, coming to my inn every night?
Sailors are used to sleeping while rocking
in cramped cabins, so they don't wake easily,
even when the town gets noisy.
But lately, maybe it's the vampire rumors,
my sailors sleep poorly, and the slightest
noise wakes them right up.
I can't bear to watch it anymore.
It was right around the time you
showed up in this town, wasn't it,
that the vampire rumors started spreading.
Suppose you tell me what's going on.
You've got something to do with it, right?
